question:
Figure 1 is an oblique photo of a machine part; figure 2 shows the same part photographed frontally. Each candidate below is a 3x3 homography given row-major as nine numbers; applying it to figure 1 is meant to rectify it into figure 2's frontal frame. At most one candidate does this correctly. Which one?
(A) [1.70312, 0.654993, -399.719, -0.373377, 2.79896, -187.315, -0.000387343, 0.00166839, 1]
(B) [1.75644, 0.404557, -265.394, -0.0968936, 2.32261, -273.644, -0.000113934, 0.00130722, 1]
(C) [6.41648, 1.73891, -1209.89, 0.744521, 9.0737, -1453.09, 0.00245067, 0.00705511, 1]
(D) None of the candidates rectifies figure 1 correctly.

Answer with only the correct option letter.

After applying candidate (B) to [img1], the resulting image [img4] still shows the nut in a similar oblique perspective as [img1]. The nut appears rotated slightly, but not fully frontal as in [img2]. The triangular black region is still present, indicating a distortion rather than a correct rectification.

</tool_call>

After applying candidate (C) to [img1], the resulting image [img5] shows the nut still in an oblique perspective. The nut appears rotated further, but not aligned frontally as in [img2]. The triangular black region is even more pronounced, indicating a greater distortion rather than a correct rectification.

Since none of the candidates (A, B, or C) seem to rectify [img1] into [img2], the correct answer is (D).
